Definition: Elon, the name of a place in Palestine, and also of one Hittite, two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Elon = "terebinth, mighty"; 1) Hittite, father-in-law of Esau; 2) second son of Zebulun; 3) Zebulonite judge of Israel; 4) town in Dan
